body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> LG presented ''LB1700'' T-DMB phone with compact design during KES 2006. It features M-XD engine, Black & robot GUI, and 170-degree viewing angle. It also supports various dial & vector fonts, PC-out, electronic dictionary, text viewer, and mobile banking service.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
